title: Waste disposal fees for large producers under EPR for packaging - GOV.UK

triage.reason: GOV.UK published official guidance on packaging waste disposal fees for large producers under UK packaging EPR, including 2026-onwards recyclability-modulated fees, payment notices, recalculation, penalties and appeals.

draft.summary: Guidance on waste disposal fees for large producers under EPR for packaging states that the fees are based on local authorities’ waste management costs and depend on the weight and type of household packaging reported. It states that for 2026 data onwards the fee for each packaging material is adjusted (‘modulated’) on the basis of how recyclable it is, in line with the recyclability assessment methodology (RAM).
draft.source_quote: Packaging waste disposal fees are based on local authorities’ waste management costs. Your fee depends on the weight and type of household packaging you report. For 2026 data onwards, the fee for each packaging material is adjusted (referred to as ‘modulated’) based on how recyclable it is, in line with the recyclability assessment methodology (RAM):

key_dates.text: Start of the assessment year that runs from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, for which PackUK published illustrative waste disposal fees in December 2025.

draft.interpretation: Analysis: fee modulation from 2026 data onwards means packaging rated green under the RAM should attract a lower waste disposal fee than red-rated formats, which may steer converters and brand owners towards more recyclable specifications.
